title: Procter & Gamble (PG) earnings Q1 2021 beat estimates
主要内容: Procter & Gamble (PG) reported Q1 2021 earnings that beat estimates, reflecting a return to normal levels in the U.S. market, except for products still recovering from stockouts. The company revised its fiscal 2021 sales growth forecast to 3% to 4%, up from 1% to 3%, and organic revenue is now expected to rise by 4% to 5%, higher than the previous 2% to 4% range. While early debt retirement will reduce net income by 5 to 20 cents per share, core earnings per share are projected to exceed prior expectations. The company also forecasts growth of 5% to 8%, up from 3% to 7%. After-tax foreign exchange impacts and freight costs are expected to reduce earnings by $375 million. P&G plans to increase its stock buyback program, raising its planned spending from $6 billion to $8 billion to $7 billion to $9 billion.
